trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks and showed an 18% error rate after its production deploy. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1; a retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all regions. Service confirmed healthy post-rollback with error rate reduced to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 failed health checks

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Deployment history review:**
- v2.3.1 (production) — unhealthy, this was the failing latest deploy
- v2.3.0 (production) — healthy, the most recent healthy release → rollback target

**Rollback:**
- First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted it after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate
- Retried the rollback, which completed successfully: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**

**Verification:**
- checkout-api is healthy across all regions, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%

**Incident:**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api. Note: the initial creation request timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it did go through — no duplicate was needed.

**Follow-up for the team:** root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before any re-deploy, and the orchestrator partial-failure issue may be worth looking into separately.
